request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
People can now name patrons from their own row, and each row shows their patrons and backing. All 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

**How it behaves**
- Each person's row has a picker listing everyone else on the sheet and an "Add patron" button. A person can't pick themselves because they aren't in their own list.
- The server checks every add. It refuses a patron who isn't on the sheet, the person themselves, or someone already named. A refusal shows `person-patron-error` on the row and writes nothing to the store or the audit file. Changing the picker clears the error.
- A successful add writes `PATRON_ADDED sheet=<id> by=<user> name=<name> patron=<patron name>` to the audit file. Adding a patron doesn't change any totals, so it writes no `ROLLUP` line, which matches what the test expects.
- `person-patrons` shows the patrons' names sorted and joined with ", ".
- `person-backing` adds up the due-totals the patrons' rows show, skipping n/a. It's 0.00 when the person has no patrons. Because it reuses the row's own due-total figure, it follows that figure through holds, voids and rate changes.

**Where the changes are**
- **Database:** a new table `person_patron` in `V18__person_patron.sql`.
- **Server:** a new `patron` package with two endpoints:
  - `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/patrons` adds a patron; a refusal returns 422.
  - `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}/patrons` lists who names whom.
- **Front end:** the names, picker and button are in `features/patrons/patrons.slot.tsx`, which loads its data from `patronsQuery.ts`. The backing cell is in `features/rates/due.slot.tsx`, next to the due-total it's built from.

I left one unused helper class, `patron/Patron.java`, in the server code; it can be deleted.
